{{Quote|The Imperial masking device he used is one of the items stolen from the naval yard in Lozash last year.|Avril Heert, to [[Major]] [[Lio Partagaz]], on the rebel pilot|<ref name="Andor 9" />}}
'''Lozash''' was located in an [[Lozash system|eponymous star system]] in the [[Bes Ber Bikade sector]]<ref name="Systems" /> within the [[Trailing Sectors]] portion<ref name="Trailing" /> of the [[Expansion Region]]. Situated at the coordinates L-15 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]],<ref name="Systems" /> it was the site of a [[Lozash naval yard|naval yard]] by the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Andor 9" /> Around [[6 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|109}} Since the episode establishes that the [[theft at Lozash]] took place in the previous [[Standard year|year]], the theft must have therefore occurred around [[6 BBY]].</ref> a number of items were [[Theft at Lozash|stolen]] from the [[Navy|naval]] yard, including an [[Imperial masking unit]].<ref name="Andor 9" />

In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the following [[Standard year|year]], the masking device was being used by a [[Unidentified rebel pilot (Anto Kreegyr)|rebel pilot]] when he was captured by the Empire on his way to the [[Ring of Kafrene]],<ref name="Andor 9" /> a trading outpost.<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> [[ISB Attendant|Attendant]] [[Corv]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] looked into the origins of the masking unit and found that the device was connected with the theft at Lozash, with fellow attendant [[Avril Heert]] relaying the information during a meeting with some of the [[ISB Board]].<ref name="Andor 9" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lozash was mentioned in "[[Nobody's Listening!]]," ninth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''<ref name="Andor 9" /> which was aired on [[November 2]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}}</ref>
